collection.title: Peugeot 3008 2017 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Peugeot 3008 SUV 2017 Onwards models requires a 27" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 17" blade on the passengers side, however some brands recommend 28" & 16". All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Slim Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have the rear blade for this 3008, simply click the Rear Blades tab below.
